quests.title: Pizza From Another Land

dialogue.t: *sigh* Is there anything in the world that will satisfy my taste buds?
Oh, the pizza you mentioned tastes really good, and it also has a lot of local ingredients.
However, I have tried the authentic Mushroom Pizza before.
I remember that the pizza was made of Cheese, Cabbage, and Mushrooms...
Hahaha, I just feel that for such outland delicacies, it's better to retain it's authentic flavor.
*sigh* Maybe I'm really not good at making pizza...
Traveler, you've returned.
How did it go, any feedback?
The original Mushroom Pizza... Hmm, it's worth a try.
The ingredients to prepare are Cheese, Cabbage, and Mushrooms...
We have the other ingredients, but we usually don't stock up on Cheese...
Traveler, could I trouble you to get a block of Cheese?

dialogue.sit: You don't really use Cheese in the store?

dialogue.t: I'm counting on you, then. Just a block of Cheese will do.
The Mushroom Pizza tastes really good, you must try it if you have the chance.
Have you brought the ingredients back with you?
Thank you, these ingredients will do.
The original Mushroom Pizza from Mondstadt, I don't know if I can make it successfully...
It's done!
This pizza looks... pretty good...
Thanks for your help, Traveler. Here, these are for you.
I'll make sure to savor this pizza's taste...
If it's not bad...it should be officially launched as a new dish soon.

quests.description: Kiminami Anna from the Kiminami Restaurant seems to be bothered by something…
